===The Bowl of Stone===
{{Checklist|*Use a cut [[Sapphire]] on a [[Bullseye lantern (unf)|Bullseye lantern frame]].
*Light the [[Sapphire lantern]] with a tinderbox.
*Climb back up the rock to the north and then use the lantern on one of the [[Light creature]]s above the chasm.
*Mine a rock, use a chisel on it and climb down the rocks to the east.
*Talk to Juna.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
